scope: Read-only frozen module exports, manifest/geometry/frame references and constructor tower data. No Game.step, attack, rendering, browser, camera, scale or combat verification.
normalization: Equivalent absent/false/0/1 defaults and float noise are recorded in raw changes but do not alone schedule sprite QA. Deployment defaults use the actual .75 fallback and do not apply to direct-only tokens/spells. Movement/collision-only changes are kept separate; actual delivery honors engine branch order, not just rangedAttack.

qaGroups.purpose: Resolve invalid clip indices/geometry before browser QA; valid indices do not prove an appropriate gesture.

For each changed cadence/burst/animation: automatic and direct attacks at 30/60 Hz, at least 3 cycles; gesture contact at real attackRelease, target impact at damage, recovery, no clock rewind; snapshots at 15 Hz. Projectile damage need not coincide with release.
Eight actual views of changed delivery/clip/emitter/projectile origin; verify first release, visual attachment and path handoff, without remeasuring global scales.

Towers with windup=interval and Tesla control: first attack, sustained firing, next sequence, reacquisition, stun, pause and 15 Hz packet batches. Check event order and visible contact independently; Tesla equality is not assumed if absent in this cut. Also verify the two changed King guards after activation.
Deploy changed counts/squads and produce tokens from their real parent; check body identity, exact members, spawn timing, split lanes and one recovery into idle. No global scale audit.
Compare real deployment time and first available attack after spawn. A card whose only control change is deployment delay needs this bounded clock check, not a fresh eight-view pose gallery.
Changed entry/death effects, dash/leap/copy/rolling/suicide/summon/spell schedules and ability removals use their actual engine path; a direct Game.attack fixture alone does not cover them.

Changed attack reach or target eligibility: acquire just inside/outside the new reach and verify beam/cone/projectile/melee outcome against eligible ground/air targets. Reuse a contact-clock or delivery scene when possible.

Ditto is a dependency case despite only movement metadata changing on its own card: transform into a changed explicit rangedAttack target below range 50 and a non-homing projectile target; verify delivery, projectile start and homing policy survive the copy.
